Rounded same stern wood joinery and tiny bronze navigation hood beside wheel; same pale navy coast and matching canvas. No text.

Farther along, reverse or varied starboard quarter view of exactly same ketch still heading toward shore, same hull and two masts/sails proportions and foredeck place as panel 1. Tiny figure scale. Alive distant cliff and clear morning visible past it, more Positano homes same story. No dock or sail shape swaps.

Distinct two young adult mothers resting fully clothed behind bow in PRECEDING view's top deck with cream pads tied inside dark wood guard. Pansy in blue and cream sits upright against secured cushions; Hermione olive and cream, freckles and messy chestnut bun relaxes close against her shoulder, no arm through body. Both wear discreet dark sunglasses and simple modest clothes. Preserve exact jewel ownership, H's one blue pendant. Her own H hand on glass or cropped, no open collar/lower body emphasis.

Robin sits upright under SAME sail shade, little padded tan mat fixed tightly to deck well inside dark wood rail. Chestnut curls and tiny dark glasses, plain pale coffee linen with tiny white vertical stripes, soft beige sandals on natural small feet. Raises one clear five-finger hand curiously at rigging in safe distance. Smooth human skin and tiny limbs, no fabric texture on skin. No second child, no dialogue.

Familiar ZEPHYR from old p10 folded flat under side wooden bulkhead on same deck. Sand textile gathered, warm golden metal chassis and wheel rims, dark brown handle, two leather safety straps anchored to wall. Totally empty, no visible baby. Small bronze latches and few deck details echo classic ketch. No words.

The two still relax in the protected nook under sail shade. Hermione holds a single normal stem glass of pale peach beverage in her left hand and has one calm sip with no other expression. Pansy own left cuff keeps fine H/R/P chain, separate bare fingers on her shoulder or near waist over their clothes. Their exact dark sunglasses and distinct olive/blue shirts and black bob/chestnut bun are clear. Bay and bronze hardware. Keep last panel bottom stroke and margin. No text.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 48

A la mañana siguiente viajan rumbo a Positano en un ketch clásico Sangermani movido por magia. Los elfos manejan las velas; Hermione, Pansy y Robin descansan a la sombra de la proa con nuevos conjuntos de lino.
Narración: Era un ketch clásico de Sangermani, construido en madera oscura y brillante, con el casco exterior pintado de un azul profundo que contrastaba con las líneas blancas de la cubierta.
pages.review: Ocho viñetas y recuadro literal de PDF617–618 revisados completos con OCR. Las dos vistas tienen dos mástiles, dos velas y tres portillos en el cuerpo de la cabina. El casco azul mantiene su línea blanca y la cubierta, su madera barnizada. El último plano se reencuadró para eliminar los dos anillos indebidos. Se verificaron los cuatro elfos, la cadena izquierda visible antes, la bebida de durazno, Robin humano en el cojín y el Zephyr plegado.
